title: Staged computational prioritization of lanmodulin binding-site designs for dysprosium-focused rare-earth separation.
authors: Rahatul Ashakin, M D; Mahata, Avik; Khan, Raiyan; Andriotakis, Gregory; Provencher, Brian; Stuetzle, Christopher; Roosan, Don
one_liner_zh: 该文开发了一个结合ProteinMPNN/LigandMPNN采样、Rosetta筛选和OpenMM几何筛查的分阶段计算流程，用于优先排序镧调素结合位点设计以实现稀土分离，虽对象涉及金属离子但核心是蛋白质结构计算设计，方法有创新但验证有限。
abstract: Rare-earth separations are energy- and solvent-intensive, motivating aqueous protein-based alternatives. We developed a staged computational workflow combining four experimental lanmodulin templates, constrained ProteinMPNN and LigandMPNN sampling, score-only Rosetta triage, and an exploratory OpenMM geometry screen to prioritize a candidate for future reduced-cluster multireference characterization. The residue-role inventory comprised 70 category memberships representing 66 unique positions because four positions belonged to two roles. Fixed-seed sequence generation and subsequent triage yielded three finalist models. Three 100 ps OpenMM replicas were evaluated for each candidate-metal combination, yielding 45 simulations. Audit of the retained systems showed that amber19-all.xml and amber19/opc3.xml were loaded, but no explicit bulk-solvent molecules or counterions were present. The retained system XMLs and execution code contained a standard NonbondedForce and no verified C4/r4 implementation; the calculations therefore cannot be described as verified 12-6-4 simulations. Every replica produced a 3.2 A any-oxygen occupancy fraction of 1.000 using oxygen atoms present in the retained topology, making this descriptor non-discriminating. The Hans pocket and AM1/Mex descriptors each averaged four target-metal sites, whereas the Hans interface descriptor averaged 14 sites, including 10 on fixed chains B-D. Cross-topology distance comparisons were therefore not site matched. Within each topology, Al(III) and Fe(III) produced shorter model-dependent distances than Dy(III), Nd(III), and Y(III), but these observations are not binding free energies or evidence of selectivity. A dimensionless Composite Quality Index, CQI = 0.7L + 0.3G, ranked the Hans chain-A pocket model highest at 0.802 and was used solely for candidate prioritization. The workflow therefore identifies a model-prioritized candidate for further computation and experiment.
abstract_zh: 稀土分离是能源和溶剂密集型的，这促使了基于水性蛋白质的替代方案的发展。我们开发了一个分阶段的计算工作流程，结合了四种实验性兰莫杜林模板、受限的ProteinMPNN和LigandMPNN采样、仅基于评分的Rosetta筛选，以及探索性的OpenMM几何筛查，以优先选择候选物用于未来的减少簇多参考表征。残基角色清单包含70个类别成员资格，代表66个独特位置，因为四个位置属于两个角色。固定种子序列生成及后续筛选产生了三个决赛模型。对每个候选金属组合评估了三个100皮秒的OpenMM副本，共进行了45次模拟。对保留系统的审计显示，加载了amber19-all.xml和amber19/opc3.xml，但不存在显式的体相溶剂分子或抗衡离子。保留的系统XML和执行代码包含标准的NonbondedForce，且没有经过验证的C4/r4实现；因此，这些计算不能描述为经过验证的12-6-4模拟。每个副本使用保留拓扑中存在的氧原子，产生了3.2埃任意氧占据分数为1.000，使得该描述符不具有区分性。Hans口袋和AM1/Mex描述符各平均了四个目标金属位点，而Hans界面描述符平均了14个位点，包括固定链B-D上的10个。因此，跨拓扑距离比较未进行位点匹配。在每个拓扑内，Al(III)和Fe(III)产生的模型依赖距离比Dy(III)、Nd(III)和Y(III)短，但这些观察结果并非结合自由能或选择性证据。一个无量纲的综合质量指数，CQI = 0.7L + 0.3G，将Hans链A口袋模型排名最高，为0.802，并仅用于候选物优先排序。因此，该工作流程确定了一个模型优先的候选物，用于进一步的计算和实验。
